narration: Katherine teaches the test under her full name, making the crowd repeat its warning until nobody confuses an answer with truth. Tessa locks the scarf-wrapped tube beside the public order and accepts the rule: never question it alone. After noon you take Naivara’s road. By one, the raised salt stones enter a ruined quarter where old laws show beneath newer signs. Wind moans through a chained platform above a dark drop; the abandoned toll bell rings once ahead, though the street is empty.

payload.note: Tessa keeps the First Answer Tube wrapped and ensures nobody questions it alone.
